$description: I CONFESS mobile information architecture. PHASE 06. Every screen names the endpoints it depends on, and design/test_ia.py verifies each one exists in design/routes.json - which is exported from the running handler, not transcribed. A screen that points at an endpoint the backend does not have is a spinner in production.

tabs.$description: Section 12: exactly five, in this order. Sourced from the navigation.bottom token rather than restated, so the two cannot disagree.

screens.title: Welcome
screens.notes: Shown once. Consent before tracking, interests before recommendations - a home feed built from nothing is a list of everything, which is the same as a list of nothing.

screens.title: Sign in
screens.notes: Root. Reachable from profile when signed out, and from any premium action when the session has expired.

screens.title: Security
screens.notes: Active sessions with revoke. Someone who suspects their account was used needs to see where it was used from.

screens.title: Home
screens.notes: Continue where you left off, then today's plan, then recommendations. A session app's home is a resume button, not a feed.

screens.title: Explore
screens.notes: The 39 categories, ordered by the server's sort_order. Never hardcoded in the client - PHASE 00.

screens.title: Confess
screens.notes: The builder's first step: what to speak over your life. Preview before committing so the user sees the plan the engine chose, not just the duration they asked for.

screens.title: Describe your session
screens.notes: Natural language to session spec: "45 minutes on fear" becomes a category, a duration and a strategy. The parsed result is always shown for confirmation before anything is created - the user is responsible for what they speak over their life, so the app never guesses silently.

screens.title: How long?
screens.notes: 10/15/30/45/60/90/120/180 plus custom. The strategy selector lives here, defaulting to balanced - the user should be able to see why a 45 minute session came back as 42.

screens.title: Which voice?
screens.notes: Rights are checked server-side before generation. A voice that cannot be licensed must not appear as selectable - PHASE 00 section 5.

screens.title: Review
screens.notes: The only place a session is created. Save as template offered here rather than buried in the player.

screens.title: Session
screens.notes: Full screen, above the tab bar at z-index player. The queue is a snapshot and must not change under the user mid-session - G-1. Progress syncs so a kill does not lose the session.

screens.title: Activity
screens.notes: History and streak. Scheduled sessions surface here rather than in a separate tab.

screens.title: New schedule
screens.notes: Scheduled sessions are a core loop requirement, not a settings afterthought.

screens.title: Shared template
screens.notes: Deep-link root. Must render something useful when the viewer is signed out - a shared prayer that demands an account before showing its own text will not be shared twice.

screens.title: Community
screens.notes: Deliberately one level down, not a tab. G-4: there is no PUBLIC visibility state yet, so this surface has nothing to publish to and must not appear in navigation until PHASE 30.

screens.title: Premium
screens.notes: Prices come from the server in the user's currency. Nothing is hardcoded. Verification is server-side - see the PHASE 04 payment bypass.

screens.title: Downloads
screens.notes: Offline playback. Downloads are licence-bound and expire; the refresh call exists because an expired licence is not the same as a missing file.

screens.title: Delete account
screens.notes: Destructive and irreversible. Requires an explicit typed confirmation and must not be reachable by accident. internal/deletion covers every user table.
